items.title: Barack Obama says goodbye to his dog Sunny
items.summary: Barack Obama announced that Sunny, the dog the family got at the start of his second term, had died: "Yesterday, we lost a cherished member of our family." The post got 329K likes.
items.author: @BarackObama

post.name: Barack Obama
post.text:
Yesterday, we lost a cherished member of our family.
